input: official filtered 10x GRCm39, Chromium 3prime v3; cortex CD45+ sorted cells
analysis_scope: Atg7 genotype by 5xFAD model; no compound/formula efficacy; no G2c/G6 reopening
independence_gate: explicit biological libraries retained; animal/pool identity must be resolved or inference withheld
qc_gate: verify all triplets, sparse integer counts and barcode uniqueness; assess per-sample core metrics; required scDblFinder before qualified cell analyses; filtered-only matrices cannot establish empty-droplet ambient correction
statistics_gate: no cell-level p-values; no inferential effects until independent biological unit and QC are qualified; no invented sex/batch
reproducibility: local input audit and offline replay; remote unconfigured
